honesty_rules: Geographic membership is not proof of delivery availability, owned local shop, speed guarantee or current flower reception policy.
Do not generate one article per legal or administrative dong just to meet counts.
Keep all 14 multi-administrative legal dongs many-to-many; 신당동 links six administrative dongs.
Do not infer a facility administrative dong from its legal dong where membership is partial. Resolve from a complete address and current official evidence if needed.
Do not apply future-effective 2026-10-12 MOIS changes to the 2026-10-10 snapshot.
